{{Quote|What do you know about Ralltiir?''"<br />"''It's a neutral world, and the only planet in the Darpa Sector that has maintained independence from the political control of Esseles. Ralltiir's financial institutions have an intergalactic reputation for their security and confidentiality.|Darth Maul and his [[C-3PX]] droid companion|<ref name="Maul Fury" />}}
'''Ralltiir''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Ralltiir system/Legends|Ralltiir system]] of the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The second planet in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Rallt]], Ralltiir had twenty-eight [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and three continents that wrapped around the planet. A major financial center in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic economy]], Ralltiir was a member world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] but remained largely neutral in galactic politics to ensure that the finances of its inhabitants remained safe from political influences and war. Located in the [[Ringali Shell]], a string of planets along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] that lay near the [[Ringali Nebula/Legends|Ringali Nebula]], Ralltiir was one of the only planets in the Darpa sector to remain independent from the [[Esselian Empire]]. Besides its financial services, Ralltiir was also a major source of [[Marble/Legends|marble]], as the planet's mountain ranges featured large deposits of marble and were riddled with quarries, and its population of 10 billion [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] was almost entirely [[Human/Legends|Humans]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] decided to make an example of Ralltiir and dispatched [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tion (Lord)/Legends|Tion]] with an Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to the Ralltiir system in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Tion's [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]] and subsequent [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|invasion]] of the planet, coupled with a blockade of the Ralltiir system that choked off the Perlemian Trade Route, lasted almost [[4 ABY/Legends|four years]]. [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Dennix Graeber]]'s corrupt rule of the shattered planet was finally ended when the [[Ralltiiri]] [[Ralltiir underground|resistance]] brought down the planet's shields and allowed the forces of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to [[Battle of Ralltiir (4 ABY)|liberate]] the world.

Ralltiir rebuilt its broken economy over the next several [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], and although the planet was briefly [[Invasion of Ralltiir|captured]] by a resurgent Empire in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], it was once again thriving by the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. However, the Ralltiiri's fear of economic instability led them to refuse asylum to [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] fleeing from the extra-galactic [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;but the planet was taken by the Yuuzhan Vong nonetheless. By [[137 ABY]], Ralltiir was a major financial center of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] under the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]], and it was the site of a pivotal [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|battle]] between Krayt's Empire, the [[Empire-in-exile]], and the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|And as I'm sure you're aware, what happens on Ralltiir affects market response all along the Perlemian Trade Route.|Minister Shirka|<ref name="Agents 2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Ralltiir_moons.png|thumb|left|200px|Ralltiir and several of its moons]]
Ralltiir was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Core Worlds" /> in the [[Ralltiir system/Legends|Ralltiir system]], a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Into the Core" /> Ralltiir [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] its [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Rallt]] in an orbital period of 255 [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]] and had a local day of 19 [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], and Ralltiir was itself orbited by twenty-eight [[Moon/Legends|moons]],<ref name="Core Worlds" /> including [[Moon Twelve]].<ref name="Legacy 36" /> A major financial center of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Ralltiir lay along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] in the [[Ringali Shell]]&mdash;a string of systems along the Perlemian that were situated closest to the Perlemian's intersection with the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. The Shell, which included the planets [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]], [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]], [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], and [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], took its name from the [[Ringali Nebula/Legends|Ringali Nebula]], a violet-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] that threaded through the region and lit up the nighttime skies of every planet in the Shell.<ref name="Into the Core" /> Ralltiir was situated approximately thirty-one hours away from Rhinnal, the next planet along the Perlemian if one was traveling south along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]],<ref name="TFOP">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref> and Ralltiir lay on the very edge of the boundary separating the Core Worlds from the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region.<ref name="Into the Core" />

A terrestrial and temperate world that measured 13,449 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in diameter,<ref name="Core Worlds" /> Ralltiir possessed a standard [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], a moderate [[Hydrosphere/Legends|hydrosphere]], and standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]].<ref name="Into the Core" /> Ralltiir possessed three main continents,<ref name="Core Worlds" /> with one located at the southern pole, a second wrapping around the equator, and a third wrapping around the planet near the northern pole.<ref name="Planets and Moons" /> The three continents all featured prominent [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges and undeveloped coastal regions with large expanses of marshes and wetlands. Much of the available land was dominated by Ralltiir's numerous [[City/Legends|cities]]. The climate and topography of Ralltiir's mountains varied greatly; the mountain ranges that were located at extreme latitudes featured glaciers, while the [[High Ontis]]&mdash;the central mountain range at the planet's equator&mdash;was arid and dotted with [[Desert/Legends|desert]] scrub. Ralltiir's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] were unique in that they experienced "balanced" tidal forces, as the gravitational pull of Ralltiir's twenty-eight moons largely counteracted each other and therefore did not cause extreme tidal activity. However, the [[Tas Sea]] was a particularly turbulent body of water on Ralltiir, and it was dotted by a number of [[Granite/Legends|granite]] outcroppings&mdash;some of which were large enough to build entire fortresses upon.<ref name="Core Worlds" />

[[File:Steadfast-Legacy2006-36.jpg|thumb|left|140px|Ralltiir]]
Ralltiir's primary exports were its financial services and [[Marble/Legends|marble]], as the planet featured significant deposits of marble. A number of marble quarries were located in the High Ontis, though they had been largely stripped of any valuable marble by the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] rise to power. Ralltiir had a well-earned reputation as a stable economic center and a haven for safe investment; most of the planet's financial institutions were politically neutral so as to protect their finances from the political maneuverings and uprisings that affected market stability. Ralltiir was also home to a [[Species/Legends|species]] of predatory birds known as [[casting hawk]]s<ref name="Core Worlds" /> as well as a creature known as the [[Ralltiiri glowmite]], and a type of fish known as the [[ralltiirieel]] was native to the planet's oceans.<ref name="Hunted" /> The [[Ralltiir tiger]] was a well-known and fierce carnivore native to Ralltiir's mountains,<ref name="Core Worlds" /> and the tigers often experienced fits of [[Blood/Legends|blood]] madness in which they would attempt to [[Death/Legends|kill]] everything around them.<ref name="Traveler" />

==History==
===Early history===
{{Quote|With Mandalorians knocking on the planetary door, Ralltiir is Taris all over again. Only this time, it's ''better''.|Marn Heirogryph|<ref name="KOTOR 13">[[Knights of the Old Republic 13|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 13]]</ref>}}
The region of the galaxy which included Ralltiir was widely explored by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from the planets [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] between [[27,500 BBY|27,500]] and [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]]. When the modern [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] was developed in 25,000 BBY, Ralltiir was one of the planets which the newly blazed Perlemian Trade Route linked together.<ref name="Atlas" /> By that [[Time/Legends|time]], the region of space that would become the Darpa sector was under the control of the [[Esselian Empire]],<ref name="Tinker">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref> but Ralltiir remained staunchly independent from that Esseles-based government, relying on its extensive interstellar banking system to maintain its independence. Client worlds and corporations helped guarantee Ralltiir's neutrality to protect their assets.<ref name="TFOP" /> Ralltiir's own currency, the [[Ralltiiri Colonial]], was approximately equal in worth to the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Galactic Credit Standard]].<ref name="Labor Pains">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/fiction/f20080409/index.html|text="Labor Pains"|int=Labor Pains|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>

[[File:Ralltiir_KOTOR.png|thumb|right|200px|Ralltiir during the Mandalorian Wars]]
Despite Ralltiir's reputation as a secure center of the galactic economy, it also had another reputation in the [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before the [[Mandalorian Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture: it was considered the place where individuals came to make poor purchasing decisions. Galactic fads such as [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] with reversible handles and sing-along [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] originated on Ralltiir in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[3963 BBY]], and Ralltiir's influence led the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] to assign a battlegroup to guard the world even before the Mandalorians reached the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Ralltiir also received an influx of [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] fleeing the Mandalorian advance in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. By that year, the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Dremullar Obohn di Garthos]] was serving as the curator of the [[Obohn Gallery of the Industrial Aesthetic]] on Ralltiir, and [[Dremullar Obohn di Garthos's brother-in-law|his brother-in-law]] was the Ralltiiri police constable.<ref name="Labor Pains" />

The [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Marn Hierogryph]] and his accomplice, the failed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]], attempted to scam Obohn into buying fake statuary, and though their scam fell apart initially, the pair ultimately succeeded in scamming Obohn for a large sum of credits.<ref name="Labor Pains" /> They later left Ralltiir aboard the stolen freighter ''[[Little Bivoli]]'', though they were forced to join part of the Republic battlegroup when the convoy departed the Ralltiir system.<ref name="KOTOR 13" /> During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Marcus Trant]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]&mdash;the Republic's intelligence agency&mdash;participated in a covert [[Operation on Ralltiir|operation]] on Ralltiir. The Human [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]] was born on Ralltiir in [[3668 BBY]],<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and the planet was represented by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Wain Andrell]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the Galactic Republic during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the Sith Empire.<ref name="Momi">{{TORcite|type=message|Momi Andrell|Senator Wain Andrell}}</ref>

===Rise of the Empire===
{{Quote|It is unlikely that the Bartokks believe they can hide from us on Ralltiir. If they suspect they are being followed, there is a high probability they landed on the planet to prepare a trap.|C-3PX|<ref name="Maul Fury" />}}
[[File:BlackSunFortress.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Alexi Garyn's fortress in the Tas Sea|link=Special:FilePath/BlackSunFortress.jpg]]
During the final decades of the Republic, [[Alexi Garyn]], the leader of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate, maintained a [[Black Sun Fortress|fortress]] in the Tas Sea as his base of operations. In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] was [[Mission to Ralltiir|sent]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Garyn and dismantle Black Sun's leadership. Maul stormed Garyn's fortress and eliminated all of the Black Sun forces present before killing the criminal leader himself.<ref name="Maul 3">[[Darth Maul (2000) 3|''Darth Maul'' (2000) 3]]</ref> Also during that year, Maul eliminated an entire hive of the [[Bartokk]] species in a remote region of Ralltiir, around thirty-eight kilometers south of the city of [[Grallia]].<ref name="Maul Fury" /> Several criminal organizations, including the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] organization [[Kalmec]], were headquartered on Ralltiir by the time of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], when hundreds of star systems were departing the Republic and joining the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Traveler" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the Separatist Crisis, Ralltiir sponsored [[Team Ralltiir]] as the planet's [[Limmie/Legends|limmie]] team in the [[Galactic Cup of Limmie]], and Team Ralltiir defeated [[Team Tralus]] in an upset match with a single score in the opening round of the Cup.<ref name="Cup">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|sports/13314_1.html|Coruscant Eliminated in Galactic Cup Opening Round}}</ref> That same year, the [[Cradle of the Galaxy]] exhibit&mdash;a display of [[Pre-Republic era]] artifacts collected by the [[Allied Tion Historical Society]]&mdash;began its year-long tour on [[Great ReSynchronization|13:4:1]] when it opened at the [[Cambriele Exploration Auditorium]], and the exhibit stayed there for roughly six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before it continued its tour of the Ringali Shell worlds along the Perlemian by heading to Rhinnal on 13:9:1.<ref name="Xim" /> After the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the Confederacy ended in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Republic was transformed into the Galactic Empire under [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Atlas" />

The financial center of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], a rival of Ralltiir, had supported the Confederacy during the war and had been largely destroyed, leaving Ralltiir with greater financial influence.<ref name="Force Unleashed">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Ralltiir's reputation as a haven soon drew supporters of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and Ralltiir was known to be the site of Rebel activity by the year [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], when the Alliance dispatched intelligence units to Ralltiir and uncovered evidence that the Empire was constructing a [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="Rebel Dawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> However, Imperial supporters infiltrated the planet's fiscal records and altered them in the spirit of the Empire's [[Humanocentrism|humanocentric]] policies. The accounts of both Rebel sympathizers and non-Human investors were wiped clean, but the [[Ralltiiri High Council]] denounced the sabotage and worked to reverse the attacks in order to maintain Ralltiir's reputation of neutrality and financial safety&mdash;actions that were influenced by Rebel sympathizers within the Ralltiiri government.<ref name="Into the Core" /> Ralltiir received further scrutiny when its citizens protested against the Empire's recent [[Operation Strike Fear|brutal campaign]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]].<ref name="EC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>

===Imperial occupation===
[[File:RalltiirTantiveIV.jpg|thumb|right|210px|The ''Tantive IV'' lands on Ralltiir.]]
{{Quote|I heard that Ralltiir was under martial law&mdash;that ''Darth Vader'' himself was on the scene.|[[Mia Ikova]]|<ref name="Empire 5">[[Empire 5|''Empire'' 5]]</ref>}}
Ralltiir's [[Unidentified female Ralltiiri Senator|Senator]] at the time pandered and deferred to Emperor Palpatine's authority throughout the entire affair,<ref name="Empire 13" /> but late in the year, Palpatine decided to make an example of the planet and dispatched [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tion (Lord)/Legends|Tion]] with an Imperial fleet to Ralltiir.<ref name="Into the Core" /> Tion's forces arrived in the month 35:2<ref name="NewsNets 3" /> and [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|bombarded]] Ralltiir's surface with his [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']].<ref name="CSWE Devastator">{{CSWECite|I|186|''Devastator''}}</ref> The [[Griffon Flight Wing]], a Rebel [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], attempted to attack the ''Devastator'', but their efforts were in vain.<ref name="Rue">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Elyhek Rue}}</ref> The [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]] was followed by an invasion of the planet's surface, and the High Council was disbanded and its members arrested.<ref name="NewsNets 3" />

Imperial soldiers occupied Ralltiir's cities and martial law was declared; the population was herded into extermination camps and suspected Rebel sympathizers were executed.<ref name="Core Worlds" /> The entire Ralltiir system was sealed off in a [[Blockade of Ralltiir|blockade]], and Tion refused to allow even relief organizations entry to the system in the [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] that followed the invasion.<ref name="NewsNets 3" /> Amid Tion's "purification campaign," Senator [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of Alderaan arrived in the Ralltiir system aboard her [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], claiming to be on a diplomatic mission to deliver relief supplies to the High Council. Organa was permitted to land, but Tion met her at the landing pad and informed her of the High Council's dissolution. Their conversation was interrupted when a group of Rebels launched a diversionary attack on Tion's forces, and Tion sent Organa back to her ship. A wounded Rebel named [[Basso]] was able to inform Organa that Tion's forces had a surveillance system set up in the city's administrative center. Organa was accosted by the Sith Lord [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Palpatine's right hand, who tried to search her vessel, but Organa manipulated Lord Tion's feelings for her in order to ensure that she could leave the planet safely.<ref name="Empire 5" />

In the early weeks of the occupation, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Akobi]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] ordered an [[Ettam massacre|attack]] on what he thought was a Rebel munitions depot&mdash;but because the Rebels were blocking his communications, the target was actually a small town called [[Ettam]].<ref name="Empire 13" /> By its second month, the Imperial blockade began to negatively affect Ralltiir's economy, as Grallia Spaceport had been shut down and the Perlemian Trade Route was effectively cut off.<ref name="NewsNets 3" /> Tion quickly installed a corrupt Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] named [[Dennix Graeber]] at the head of a military tribunal, and despite Tion's death on Alderaan a few weeks after the start of the occupation, Imperial forces retained military control over the planet for the next few years.<ref name="Core Worlds" /> Graeber grew wealthy by orchestrating a complex network of "corrupt" inspection officials, [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], and contacts that moved contraband military supplies to Rebel cells on Ralltiir, and he used the armed status of the cells to justify further crackdowns on the populace.<ref name="Into the Core" />

[[File:Raltirbattle.jpg|thumb|left|190px|Ralltiir's embattled capital]]
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], in the months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], in which the Alliance won a powerful victory against the Empire, the Empire became aware that two Rebel [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] were hiding on Ralltiir, and dispatched two additional Star Destroyers to bombard the planet until the two surrendered. However, the Alliance's [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] was sent to Ralltiir to extract the scientists, who were trapped under a [[DSS-02 shield generator/Legends|DSS-02 shield generator]] surrounding the capital of [[Cambriele]] with a force of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT walkers]] searching the nearby region for them. Commander [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sarkli]] were [[Defense of Ralltiir|sent to defend]] the city with [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]] and ensure that the scientists escaped. The Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] destroyed the three bridges around the city in order to halt the AT-ATs' advance, but Sarkli's defection to the Empire alerted Skywalker and Antilles to the fact that the battle was a trap. Skywalker, Antilles, and a number of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] under the command of Captain [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]] were forced to fight their way through Cambriele and escort the scientists off planet, successfully bypassing the Imperial blockade.<ref name="Rogue Squadron III">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>

Graeber was still in power in late [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], when authorities launched a raid three weeks in the planning against a secret Rebel armory in the commercial sector of [[Salibury]] in the early morning of 37:2:11. The raid resulted in the capture of thirty-five Rebels and over 300 tons of weaponry.<ref name="NewsNets 9" /> It was not until [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], several months after the death of Emperor Palpatine at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], that the planet was [[Battle of Ralltiir (4 ABY)|liberated]]; the [[Ralltiir underground]] knocked out Ralltiir's planetary shields, allowing a fleet of six [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] sent by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]&mdash;the Alliance's successor state&mdash;to attack the planet.<ref name="Heroes & Rogues" /> Ralltiir began to rapidly rebuild its shattered economy, which had been forced to rely on the planet's still-plentiful marble reserves during the Imperial occupation. However, the Imperial invasion of the Core Worlds during [[Operation Shadow Hand]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] sent the markets into recession again when nearly all of Ralltiir was evacuated, and was [[Invasion of Ralltiir|conquered]] by the Empire. Fortunately for Ralltiir's economy, the reborn Emperor Palpatine was defeated shortly afterward, and the Imperial offensive collapsed in the Core, allowing Ralltiir to resume its role as a major financial center.<ref name="Core Worlds" />

===Later history===
[[File:Grallia_Spaceport.png|thumb|right|180px|Grallia Spaceport]]
{{Quote|The Ralltiiri Secretariat has vetoed the proposal that would have allowed us to accept any displaced peoples.''"<br />"''I thought so. And just what am I supposed to do with the six thousand refugees who were promised temporary shelter on Ralltiir?''"<br />"''I'm afraid that's not for me to decide.''"<br />"''But the Secretariat agreed to this last week. What could have changed since then?''"<br />"''It's rather complicated. But to be concise, the idea of accepting refugees didn't sit well with several of our more influential off-world investors. That, of course, led the central banks to pressure the Ministry of Finance, and&hellip;|Minister Shirka and Leia Organa|<ref name="Agents 2" />}}
In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], as the intergalactic [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] the galaxy, Ralltiir was represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by [[Ab'el Bogen]].<ref name="Agents 1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref> Later that year, as more and more systems fell to the Yuuzhan Vong, the [[Ralltiiri Secretariat]] agreed to provide temporary shelter to almost six thousands refugees. However, by the time [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] Leia Organa Solo arrived with the refugees at Ralltiir, the Secretariat had vetoed the proposal, as several of the planet's investors had objected and caused the banks to pressure the [[Ralltiir Ministry of Finance]] and so on until the Secretariat had been forced to revise the decision. Solo and the refugees were denied landing privileges at Grallia Spaceport, and despite Solo's attempts to convince [[Minister]] [[Shirka]] to change the decision, the refugees were forced to go to the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Ruan]].<ref name="Agents 2" /> By [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], Ralltiir had been conquered by the Yuuzhan Vong, and transports containing Ralltiiri refugees were used as missiles by the Yuuzhan Vong to destroy Coruscant's shields during their [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attack]] on the New Republic's capital.<ref name="Star by Star">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref> [[Syal Antilles]], the daughter of the famous New Republic pilot Wedge Antilles, changed her name to Lysa Dunton in a Ralltiiri court that had a reputation for being horribly disorganized sometime before [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].<ref name="Betrayal" />

By [[137 ABY]], Ralltiir had come under the control of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] under the Sith Lord [[Darth Krayt]], and the [[Coruscant Third Fleet]] under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Peto Kelsan]] was stationed in the Ralltiir system in addition to the planetary defenses set up on Ralltiir's moons. That year, the forces of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] under Admiral [[Gar Stazi]] entered the Ralltiir system and [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|attacked]] the Third Fleet, wiping out part of the planetary defense network and inflicting damage on the Third Fleet in the early stages of the battle.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

[[File:Battle_of_Ralltiir.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Imperial, Fel, and Alliance fleets engage each other above Ralltiir.]]
Not long into the fighting, the [[Bastion Second Fleet]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]], the Empire under Emperor [[Roan Fel]], arrived to support Stazi as part of his new alliance with Emperor Fel. The Second Fleet's Admiral [[Edouard Fenel]] called upon the Third Fleet's personnel to honor their loyalty to the Emperor Fel, the true Emperor, and most of the Third Fleet accepted Fenel's demands and surrendered. However, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vaclen Tor]] of the Third Fleet [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Steadfast (Ardent-class)|''Steadfast'']] refused to surrender, and his resistance inspired Admiral Kelsan to take back his previous surrender. Kelsan ordered his ships to set their self-destructs and to launch escape pods, but Fenel's promise to destroy the escape pods led Admiral Stazi to place the Alliance fleet between the Bastion and Coruscant fleets as a shield. The resultant standoff ended when Emperor Fel himself ordered Fenel to stand down, and Stazi left the still-intact ''Steadfast'' on Ralltiir as a gift for Fel.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

==Inhabitants==
[[File:Ralltiir_banker.png|thumb|right|60px|A Ralltiiri banker]]
{{Quote|Regardless of who gained what, is it Ralltiir's intention to remain neutral in the coming storm to avoid disturbing the privileged lives of its wealthy residents and investors?|Leia Organa|<ref name="Agents 2" />}}
Ralltiir was primarily inhabited by Humans, with Humans making up 96% percent of the planet's population of 10 billion inhabitants.<ref name="Core Worlds" /> [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], Wookiees, and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] were among the various [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species who also made Ralltiir their home.<ref name="Traveler" /> Ralltiirians<ref name="You Can't Take it with You" /> or [[Ralltiiri]], as the natives of Ralltiir were most commonly known, were considered to be cultured and dedicated to the financial industry, though their society was split by pro-Imperial and pro-Rebel factions during the Galactic Civil War. Almost all professionally employed Ralltiiri were involved in finance, and the few who were not were involved in crime or worked as artisans or laborers in the marble-mining industry. The large number of Humans on Ralltiir led to a cultural tendency for the planet's elite to adopt the current culture and dress of Coruscant, and the tendency was particularly strong during the reign of the Empire. A number of corporations controlled Ralltiir's mining industry, including [[XwiziMarble]] and the Imperial-subsidized [[Ralltiir Consolidated Marble]]. The [[Regency Spires Imperial Trust]] was one of the few companies to survive the Imperial occupation largely intact, as it primarily served Imperial officers and officials. The [[Trel family]] was an influential family of investors native to both Ralltiir and Coruscant.<ref name="Core Worlds" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|The next item up for auction is number seventy-one-dash-zero-zero in the catalog-a chandelier from the principal dining room of Ralltiir's Darpa Hotel. Made of electrum, the piece has undergone substantial restoration but is fully provenanced.|An auctioneer in 43 ABY|<ref name="Millen">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Ralltiir_Financial_district.png|thumb|left|150px|The financial district of Grallia]]
Ralltiir's capital was the city of Cambriele, which was the site of the famous Cambriele Exploration Auditorium and the [[Dusky Sky Café]]<ref name="Traveler" /> as well as the home of the [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]]-manufacturing [[Cambriele SolidState]].<ref name="Into the Core" /> Salibury was a substantial city-state and one of Ralltiir's major population centers along with the city of Grallia,<ref name="Traveler" /> which sat across the idyllic [[Lake Grallia]] from the sprawling [[Grallia Spaceport]]. The [[University Faculty Medical Center]] was also located on the shores of Lake Grallia.<ref name="Core Worlds" /> Ralltiiri architecture was rather varied in style; numerous styles and types of buildings were mixed throughout the planet's cities, with old and new buildings side by side. Unlike some other Core Worlds, the buildings of Ralltiir's cities were not segregated economically.<ref name="Traveler" /> [[Demilla City]] was another city on Ralltiir,<ref name="NewsNets 9" /> and the [[Darpa Hotel]] was a famous hotel that existed on Ralltiir sometime before [[43 ABY]].<ref name="Millen" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ralltiir was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]] in [[1981]],<ref name="Radio">[[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]</ref> and the Empire's subjugation of the planet has been mentioned in a number of sources over the following decades.

Ralltiir has been occasionally misspelled as both Raltiir and Ralltir in different publications, such as the [[Knights of the Old Republic 13|thirteenth]] issue of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Knights of the Old Republic'' comic series]]<ref name="KOTOR 13" /> and the [[Star Wars: Rebellion: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Rebellion'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]].<ref name="Rebellion Prima">[[Star Wars: Rebellion: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Rebellion'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> The [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Ralltiir in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] of the Galactic Core,<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> though the Fakir sector is actually in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The roleplaying guide ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'' mistakenly used the image of the planet Rhinnal in its entries for both Rhinnal and Ralltiir,<ref name="Core Worlds" /> and ''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]'' repeated the mistake by using Rhinnal's picture for Ralltiir.<ref name="Force Unleashed" />

Ralltiir was cut from the [[2006]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'' before the game was released, though images of the planet remained in the game's files.<ref name="Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>
